The case is about smuggling (走私) of solid waste (废旧电子产品) and also there were other ordinary goods hidden (普通货物) but the defendants (应志某, 陆某) did not have knowledge or intent regarding those hidden goods. The court concluded they have no intent for the ordinary goods, so they are not liable for the crime of smuggling ordinary goods. They are liable for smuggling solid waste (which is prohibited). The text says: "构成××" (some placeholder). Likely the crime is "走私固体废物罪" (smuggling solid waste) or "走私废旧电子产品罪". In Chinese criminal law, there is a specific offense: "走私废旧电子产品罪" (smuggling waste electronic products) under Article 151? Actually Article 151 of Criminal Law: "走私、非法买卖、运输、携带、邮寄、储存国家禁止进出口的货物、物品或者废物的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" There's also a specific offense for smuggling solid waste: "走私固体废物罪". So the appropriate label: "走私固体废物". The examples earlier used "走私珍贵动物制品罪" etc. So answer likely: [罪名]走私固体废物<eoa>. Possibly also "走私普通货物" not applicable. So single crime.

Thus final answer: [罪名]走私固体废物<eoa>
